integrity: Complete proof and reproducible finite-field and ring checks; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative short Gorenstein local rings with embedding dimension at least two; graph does not recover ring characteristic. The projective pairing reduction was published in 2020; unindexed equivalent reconstruction theorems remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Graph-isomorphism classification for compressed zero-divisor graphs of short Gorenstein local rings
